candidates.title: Explicit settlement domains and relocation
candidates.behavioral_need: A program declares the state/effects covered by one atomic commit and preserves pending relocation or external-leg duties outside it.
candidates.positive_witness: Inputs from two synchronizers are reassigned to one admissible execution domain and then atomically exchanged.
candidates.negative_witness: One input is unassigned, the other cannot move, yet a UI reports complete DvP.
open_PL_hypotheses: Effect-indexed atomic regions; spatial/ownership modalities; trace refinement with preparatory relocation.
candidates.Midnight_obligations: Map atomic region and failure behavior to actual guaranteed/fallible Midnight phases. PCD alone cannot synchronize independent chains.
candidates.proof_status: Proposed behavioral obligation, not proved or implemented.

candidates.title: Netting preserves authorized gross economics
candidates.behavioral_need: An optimization may reduce funding/transfer movements only while preserving all authorized leg identities, parties, fees, liabilities and cumulative bounds.
candidates.positive_witness: Two offsetting obligations use net funding but retain both consent records and fee/liability evolution.
candidates.negative_witness: A zero-net batch adds unauthorized gross turnover or resets per-fill fees.
open_PL_hypotheses: Semantic refinement between gross obligation graph and net settlement; dimensioned resource algebras; certified netting primitive.
candidates.Midnight_obligations: Prove both source-valid completeness and arbitrary-witness soundness for netting circuits; account for exact arithmetic/rounding and phase-retained fees.
candidates.proof_status: Proposed behavioral obligation, not proved or implemented.

candidates.title: Semantic obligations for interchangeable settlement implementations
candidates.behavioral_need: Using an interface requires verifiable meaning for consume/release/settled outcomes, not matching method names alone.
candidates.positive_witness: A certified token implementation consumes a settlement right once and returns effects corresponding to its declared outcome.
candidates.negative_witness: A structurally valid implementation returns Pending or omits consumption while caller reports delivery.
open_PL_hypotheses: Behavioral subtyping; proof-carrying modules; effect/postcondition contracts; assume-guarantee linking.
candidates.Midnight_obligations: Bind code/profile/verifier semantics in signed intention and prove compositional target correspondence. Certification must be objective, not a project allowlist.
candidates.proof_status: Proposed behavioral obligation, not proved or implemented.

candidates.title: Separate evidence approval from funding and withdrawal commitment
candidates.behavioral_need: Report whether a request is acknowledged, allocated, funded, revocable, committed, pending further approvals or settled; show any no-unilateral-exit condition.
candidates.positive_witness: An uncommitted allocation withdraws lawfully; a committed allocation disallows withdrawal until its signed time policy permits it.
candidates.negative_witness: Committed funds with no deadline are displayed as automatically refundable.
open_PL_hypotheses: Typestate plus quantitative reservations; explicit commitments and revocation windows; progress under named cooperation.
candidates.Midnight_obligations: Preserve cancellation and permission semantics across target phases; no hidden global timeout rule or invented refund.
candidates.proof_status: Proposed behavioral obligation, not proved or implemented.

candidates.title: Cancellation survives late-created commitments
candidates.behavioral_need: A cancellation leaves sufficient authenticated state and authority to handle allocations/results that may lawfully arrive later.
candidates.positive_witness: Cancel records a terminal decision while late funding is rejected or returned through an authorized recovery transition.
candidates.negative_witness: Consume the only cancel authority, then allow late funding to become stranded.
open_PL_hypotheses: Persistent tombstone/cancellation capability; revocation frontier; causal cut and distributed termination evidence.
candidates.Midnight_obligations: Prove no double delivery/refund and retention of all residual duties. A cleanup proof must account for the entire allowed late-arrival scope.
candidates.proof_status: Proposed behavioral obligation, not proved or implemented.

candidates.title: Distinguish preferred dates from enforced deadlines
candidates.behavioral_need: A signed/displayed time identifies its clock, enforcement point, inequality and operation scope; metadata must not be mistaken for an enforced restriction.
candidates.positive_witness: Displayed settlement date is labeled preferred while enforceable release deadline is checked at its actual validity cut.
candidates.negative_witness: Finance settlementTime metadata is advertised as an automatic expiration/refund guarantee.
open_PL_hypotheses: Temporal refinement types; explicit clock observations; boundary predicates rather than ambiguous expiry labels.
candidates.Midnight_obligations: Use actual Midnight clock/phase rules and trusted observations; show late known success instead of forcing unknown.
candidates.proof_status: Proposed behavioral obligation, not proved or implemented.

candidates.title: Security-driven bounded settlement and recursive lineage
candidates.behavioral_need: A proof-carrying stage preserves asset, authority, evidence and residual-duty invariants from authenticated predecessors under a bounded decidable checking relation.
candidates.positive_witness: A valid two-fill history satisfies both per-fill and aggregate bounds and can still recover a late branch.
candidates.negative_witness: Two individually valid proofs fork from the same predecessor and both spend its funding unless ledger uniqueness rejects one.
open_PL_hypotheses: Inductive trace invariants; linear/affine rights with persistent duties; bounded transition predicates; certified effect summaries.
candidates.Midnight_obligations: Actual ZKIRv3 constraints and ledger uniqueness are mandatory. Reject invalid witnesses; provide valid non-fixture witnesses. Turing incompleteness and PCD do not prove price fairness, external truth or liveness.
candidates.proof_status: Proposed behavioral obligation, not proved or implemented.
